technology_name: ACTIVE BALANCING METHOD FOR STRINGS OF ULTRA CAPACITORS
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Passive balancing of ultracapacitors wastes substantial energy as heat through resistors, while classic active balancing topologies are too slow to resolve steep voltage variations.
description: An active buck-boost equalizer circuit protocol designed to control voltage variations across ultracapacitor strings by applying a low-loss balancing logic directly through the magnetic coupled inductors of the active framework.
applications: Regenerative braking energy recovery banks, industrial automated guided vehicle (AGV) fast-chargers, heavy elevator hoist energy buffers, and grid stabilization units.
